description: Get one sweep run by `id`, with its status and summary worked out from its test runs, and `testRuns`: one row per persona with the test run id, testConfigId, profileId, status, outcome and times. Use when: the user asks which personas passed or failed in a sweep. For why one persona's run failed use getRunResults with its test run id. Read-only for the caller. Needs testing:read. Returns 404 if the run is not in your workspace.
name: getSweepRun

allOf.description: One execution of a `TestSweep` — one TestRun per profile.

summary.description: Roll-up counters for a sweep run.

testRunIds.description: TestRun IDs created by this sweep (one per profile).

outputSchema.description:
Variant returned by `GET /testing/sweep-runs/{id}` — the sweep run plus inlined
detail for each constituent `TestRun`. Additional fields may surface as the
aggregator evolves; treat as a superset of `TestSweepRun`.

title: Get Sweep Run
